attempts.text: [{"name": "timed_transition", "idea": "Timing-aware sequential signal: for each of u's last 5 items i, taken o = A - t steps ago (o <= 60), sum the share of i's adopters in the last 180 steps who took j at a gap g after i with o <= g < o + 30, so it estimates how likely j is to fall exactly in the label window.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 180), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, o FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, {A} - t AS o, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 5 AND o <= 60), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), ni AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e WHERE item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY item_id), tr AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, b.t - a.t AS g, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e a JOIN e b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND b.t > a.t AND b.t <= a.t + 90 WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(CAST(tr.c AS DOUBLE) / ni.c) AS ag_timed_tr FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN tr ON tr.i = lu.item_id AND tr.j = c.item_id AND tr.g >= lu.o AND tr.g < lu.o + 30 JOIN ni ON ni.item_id = tr.i GROUP BY 1, 2;"}, {"name": "adopter_depth_gap", "idea": "Signed match between the candidate's typical adopter activity (mean ln total items of its adopters in the last 90 steps) and the user's own ln total items, so heavy users get niche items and light users broad ones.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH un AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ev GROUP BY user_id), idp AS (SELECT e.item_id, AVG(LN(un.n)) AS d FROM ev e JOIN un ON un.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.t >= {A} - 90 GROUP BY e.item_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, idp.d - LN(un.n) AS ag_depth_gap FROM cand c JOIN un ON un.user_id = c.user_id JOIN idp ON idp.item_id = c.item_id;"}, {"name": "cooc30_relative", "idea": "Within-user normalized recent co-occurrence: the 30-step cosine score over the user's last 10 items divided by the maximum of that score over the user's candidates, making the signal comparable across users with different history strength.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH r AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30), n AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM r GROUP BY item_id), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 10), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), co AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS c FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id <> b.item_id WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2), s AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(co.c / sqrt(ni.c * nj.c)) AS v FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN co ON co.i = lu.item_id AND co.j = c.item_id JOIN n ni ON ni.item_id = co.i JOIN n nj ON nj.item_id = co.j GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT user_id, item_id, v / MAX(v) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS ag_cooc30_rel FROM s;"}, {"name": "lastyear_share_gap", "idea": "Seasonal level: the item's log audience share in the window one cycle before the label window [A-365, A-335) minus its log audience share in the last 30 steps, so items that were relatively bigger at this time last cycle are flagged for a rebound.", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH w AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 365 AND t < {A} - 335), tot AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM w), ly AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS c FROM w GROUP BY item_id), r AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30), curt AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM r), cur AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS c FROM r GROUP BY item_id), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM ev) SELECT it.item_id, LN((COALESCE(ly.c, 0) + 1.0) / GREATEST(tot.n, 1)) - LN((COALESCE(cur.c, 0) + 1.0) / GREATEST(curt.n, 1)) AS ag_ly_share_gap FROM it LEFT JOIN ly ON ly.item_id = it.item_id LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.item_id = it.item_id CROSS JOIN tot CROSS JOIN curt;"}, {"name": "segment_pop30", "idea": "Popularity within the user's activity segment: the share of users in the same log2 bucket of last-30-step item count who took item j in the last 30 steps, since light and heavy users favour different items.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH a AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30 GROUP BY user_id), b AS (SELECT user_id, LEAST(CAST(FLOOR(LOG2(1 + n)) AS INTEGER), 4) AS k FROM a), bs AS (SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS s FROM b GROUP BY k), ip AS (SELECT b.k, e.item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM ev e JOIN b ON b.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.t >= {A} - 30 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, CAST(COALESCE(ip.c, 0) AS DOUBLE) / bs.s AS ag_seg_pop30 FROM cand c JOIN b ON b.user_id = c.user_id JOIN bs ON bs.k = b.k LEFT JOIN ip ON ip.k = b.k AND ip.item_id = c.item_id;"}]
